rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
absolutive expressing prior act of knowing
compound object of knowing; gūḍha (hidden) + sadbhāva (true-nature)
main verb indicating emergence of omniscience

items.question: What state emerges from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: The hidden true nature can be known.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a transformative realization.
Omniscience is a state that can arise.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature results in the arising of omniscience.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
